_comment: How tools/gen_data.py treats Biohazard Outbreak (SLPM_654.28) data. Addresses are PS2 addresses.
_raw: VU microcode, then EE kernel-mode code copied to 0x8007xxxx at boot: bytes, never pointers
_overlays: all the overlays on the disc (EDITOR.BIN isn't): the game switches between them; submain stays resident and main's code uses its variables
_owners: addresses the C names that several overlays cover: which overlay the code means
_number: words (or [start, end) ranges) that look like addresses but aren't: 0x218E80 and 0x559540 (demo) are tables of offsets into demo_com.tex and select.tex
